# Valentine's Day Prop Firm Deals

This dataset tracks every Valentine's Day deal published on PropFirmDiscount.com by a
prop firm carrying a verified discount code.

Deals tracked: 31 across 26 firms. Newest deal: 2026-02-15.
Every deal row carries that firm's discount code, which works any time.

Event page: https://propfirmdiscount.com/tag/valentines-day/
Event dataset: https://propfirmdiscount.com/api/prop-firm-events/
Deal rows for this event: https://github.com/propfirmdiscounts/valentines-day-prop-firm-deals
All firms: https://github.com/propfirmdiscounts/prop-firm-discount-codes
